name: ace
description: Code Engine ACE - Intelligent pattern learning with continuous auto-search. v7.1.3: Subagent session-anchoring correctness + SubagentStop observability. No floor bump. R2: unconditional task_session_id seed — ace_before_task and ace_subagent_start now persist the per-task uuid4 to the patterns-used state file BEFORE the search and any early-exits (via an empty-ids seed write), so a subagent that searched successfully but then hit an early-exit still carries session_id on its trace and the server anchors it to the stamped search rows (recovers eval-gold previously lost). Verified byte-identical: the seeded uuid4 IS the same value passed as --pin-session. R1: SubagentStop invariant monitor — ace_after_task emits a subagent_stop_keymap record (read_key, transcript_uuid, invariant_ok) to ace-relevance.jsonl on every SubagentStop; a prior transcript-recovery branch was removed after live probes proved it structurally inert (read_key always == transcript_uuid, 5/5). v7.1.2: Injection quality + correctness hardening. Quality gate keep iff NOT isAtRisk AND cumulative_v15_reward >= 0. Domain-shift bounded server-side via --top-k 8. Floor bump: ace-cli >= 4.1.2, @ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2. v7.1.1: Domain-shift session-pinning + strip/gate hardening. Floor bump: ace-cli >= 4.1.2, Claude Code >= 2.1.163, @ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2. v7.1.0: Per-agent ACE attribution — SubagentStart per-subagent search + per-TASK session_id. v7.0.2: Fix outdated /ace:ace-doctor. v7.0.0: ACE 1.5 / ace-cli 4.0.1 compatibility milestone. Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.163, ace-cli >= 4.1.2 (@ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2).
